highlights: Earn up to 10% cashback on dining and food delivery, up to 8% on travel & entertainment, up to 3% on shopping & lifestyle, and up to 3% on health & wellness spend with a min. monthly spend of S$800. Spend categories with boosted rebate rates are each capped at S$25 per month; if spend is less than S$800, 0.3% cash rebate will be awarded on all other spend with no cap.
pros: 10% cash rebate on dining & online food delivery globally.
pros: 8% cash rebate on travel & entertainment spend (MY &ID in-store spend, online travel booking, concert booking, streaming subscriptions).
pros: 3% cashback on shopping & lifestyle spend (contactless bus & train rides, ride hailing, supermarkets, online purchases).
pros: Up to 3% cashback on health & wellness spend (hospital bills, vet services & pet shop spend, insurance).
pros: 0.3% cashback for all other spend categories.
pros: First year annual fee waived for principal and supplementary cards.
cons: S$800 min. monthly spend required to unlock boosted cashback rates.
cons: Boosted cashback categories (Dining & Online Food Delivery / Travel & Entertainment / Shopping & Lifestyle / Health & Wellness) are capped at S$25 each per billing cycle.
cons: S$207.10 annual fee (inclusive of GST).
